data.jd_text:
**1 Mission** 




 The Project Director is in charge of the complete implementation of the management strategy for projects under his/her responsibility, and for which he/she has the support of resources either inside or outside the affiliate.
 



 To meet the expectations of Clients, for whom he/she is the direct and key contact, the Project Director supervises architectural and technical studies. Every decision of design modification leading to financial consequences is taken by him/her. At the same time, he/she guarantees the economic balance of the project and the respect of Quality principles. He/she also deals with all the contractual issues between Artelia Airports and its clients.
 



 In the management of studies, the Project Director supervises the project teams made available. He/she draws up and manages design contracts entered into with designers outside Artelia Airports and guarantees their functioning. With the support of the functional resources of affiliates, he/she defines the subcontracting strategy, then drafts and manages the subcontracting contracts necessary to project implementation.
 



 He/She contributes to the definition of the affiliate’s strategic focus.
 



  





**2 Line and Staff Relations** 




 The role will directly report to the Director, Production and Operations and will work in close collaboration with the following teams:
 



  




* ARTELIA AIRPORTS Staff
* Design Manager
* Contract Administrator
* Director of Tendering and Consulting
* Resident Engineer
* Planning Engineer
* Design Team, all disciplines
* Supervision Team at site
* QA/QC
* HSE
* External Collaborators
* Client Representatives
* Sub\-Consultants
* Contractors / Sub\-Contractors



  





**3 Key Responsibilities** 




 Ensures the management of signed contracts
 


* He/she negotiates the technical and financial approach to projects in his/her portfolio (with Management assisted by the Business Development)
* He/she defines the progress of the project (consistent with the Client’s specifications) and the recourse to outside resources (subcontracting)
* He/she defines the technical, budgetary and financial resources necessary
* He/she defines resources to be implemented and monitoring indicators
* He/she monitors Management’s continuous and adequate information as far as finance, technical choices and deadlines are concerned, in providing the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations with the data necessary to their audit (Control Panels and performance indicators)
* He/she uses feedback information from the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations in the management of his project
* He/she supervises studies and manages teams:
* breaks specifications down into study objectives and study team needs
* establishes the monitoring indicators of studies to be carried out
* directs, focuses and coordinates the group of project contributors, i.e. :
* is in charge of teams under his/her direct responsibility.
* focuses and coordinates the work of outside designers.
* coordinates the work of teams, including those teams working on the site.
* monitors subcontractors.
* monitors Artelia Airports spending and manages it in relation to projected financial schedules.
* guarantees project / Client program appropriateness (functional and technical aspects, study and finishing deadlines and target costs)
* monitors Quality and the respect of project deadlines through continuous dialogue with outside designers (optimization of economic choices, project consistency)
* contributes to the concrete production of studies
* updates the Director of Operations and Production on technical bases
* He/she manages Client relations:
* conducts the technical dialogue on the project with the Client (technical choices, functionality)
* validates the various stages of the project with the Client
* conducts the closure of services due under contracts entered into with Clients
* implements the contracts entered into with the Clients
* monitors the deadlines, quality and costs follow\-up
* is responsible to report to executive management any changes of the Artelia Airports contract
* prepares, with support from the Business Development Manager, the technical and financial files for possible complaints (follow\-up letters etc…)
* advises the Business Development Manager and Executive Management in terms on market opportunities when required
* He/she updates load plans by:
* Defining staff needs according to their skills
* Allowing or denying additional missions
* Accepting vacations
* Managing all the means needed for his project
* Contractors:
* signs all the instructions to the contractor including:
* notice to proceed and eventually to stop the works on site
* technical variation orders
* financial variation orders
* schedule variation orders
* penalty orders for delay
* validates all the contractors’ submissions and quality control plans produced by contractors or he/she can delegate such responsibility.
* He/she follows the project for Artelia Airports by :
* Following its spending and invoices
* Approving the schedule for the project
* Approving the missions and reporting it to the Managing Director
* Within the framework of his activities, the Project Director contributes, in a relevant manner, to the fulfillment of Quality objectives.



  





**4 Profile Specifications – Minimum Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in airport management, planning, aviation science, or engineering.
* 15 years’ experience minimum on large size construction projects or similar transportation projects in a similar position, with a minimum of 3 airport projects references strongly preferred \- both design and site supervision.
* Thorough knowledge of engineering design, construction estimating, facility operation, project budgeting and scheduling.
* Demonstrated knowledge of capital planning and assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, planning and evaluation, and risk management protocols
* Experienced in Project Management and FIDIC contracts
* Experience in ICAO and IATA regulations is a plus
* Excellent presentation, coordination and leadership skills
* Knowledge of local laws and regulations, international codes and standards
* Fluent in English; reading, writing and speaking
* Proficiency in the use of standard Microsoft Office products, Primavera (Oracle’s Project Management software) or MS Project.
* Eligibility for frequent travels to be expected.
* SoE membership and AUH Engineering license are mandatory or proven eligibility



  





***Note to external recruiters:***
*Please note that Artelia Airports does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, Artelia Airports will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, Artelia Airports explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Artelia Airports and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Artelia Airports as a result of the referral or through other means.*

data.jd_text:
Since first going into action in 1909, the BESIX Group has over the years grown into a multidisciplinary company with a leading position in its markets: construction, property development and concessions. BESIX Contracting specializes in construction, infrastructure and marine works, often in contracts with a high level of complexity. In Benelux and France, the Group’s regional affiliates BESIX Infra, Belemco, Cobelba, Jacques Delens, Vanhout, Wust and Lux TP ensure a strong presence and a local approach. With Franki Foundations, West Construct, Socogetra, BESIX Environment and Van den Berg, the Group offers specialist niche solutions for the building market like deep foundations, geo\-engineering, road construction, water treatment and cable and pipeline construction.
   

  





 Backed by our experience in our home markets, we have built up strong positions outside Europe. A typical example is the Middle East, where over a 50 year period we have built up an impressive portfolio. This diversification in activities and geography pays off by reducing our risk exposure
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**




 The Project Director is responsible for leading the successful delivery of large\-scale marine construction projects (USD 300M\+) across the GCC region. This role carries full accountability for project P\&L, execution strategy, and delivery performance, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
   

  





 The position requires a hands\-on leader from a Tier 1 marine contractor background, with proven experience in delivering complex marine works such as breakwaters, dredging, reclamation, quay walls, and port infrastructure within the GCC.
   

  





**What You’ll Drive**

data.jd_text:
Job description:
   

  

**About Us** 

 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
 


**Line of Service Overview** 

 At PwC, our people in tax services focus on providing advice and guidance to clients on tax planning, compliance, and strategy. These individuals help businesses navigate complex tax regulations and optimise their tax positions.
 


**Business Unit Overview** 

 In Corporate Tax, you will focus on offering Corporate Tax advisory working with our Delivery Centre on compliance, dispute resolution and tax accounting services to clients. You will provide advice and guidance on tax planning, strategy, helping businesses optimise their tax positions and navigate complex tax regulations to ensure compliance. 
 



  
 



**Role overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Corporate Tax Director to lead complex engagements across the UAE, advising multinational groups, regional conglomerates, family offices and sovereign wealth funds on UAE Corporate Tax and related advisory matters. The role combines market leadership, technical excellence, and people management, with accountability for client portfolio growth, quality execution, and risk management. You will be a senior member of the leadership team, shaping our go‑to‑market strategy and coaching high‑performing teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes. 
 


**How You’ll Contribute** 

**Key responsibilities** 




 You will support the Corporate Tax Partners and lead and oversee a diverse portfolio covering advisory, compliance, controversy, and transactions: 
 



 Client leadership and advisory 
 


* Serve as lead advisor on UAE Corporate Tax matters under Federal Decree‑Law No. 47 of 2022 and implementing decisions, including group structuring, free zone regimes, participation exemption, interest limitation, deductibility, loss utilisation, business restructuring, and permanent establishment and nexus analyses.
* Lead complex transactions and reorganisations, including due diligence, tax structuring, SPA tax clauses, step‑plan design, post‑deal integration, and tax accounting implications.



 Engagement delivery and quality 
 


* Set engagement strategy, scope, budgets, and staffing plans; ensure timely, high‑quality deliverables aligned to global methodologies, independence, and risk management requirements.
* Review and sign‑off technical analyses, memoranda, models, and client reports; ensure clear articulation of positions and defensibility under UAE law and OECD standards.
* Oversee tax compliance for complex groups, including registrations, elections, group relief/consolidation, returns, and tax accounting/disclosures under IFRS; ensure robust documentation and workpapers.



 Market development 
 


* Drive business development with existing and new clients; originate and convert pipeline; lead proposals, thought leadership, and market eminence initiatives focused on priority sectors (financial services, energy, real estate, technology, consumer/retail, logistics, sovereign/PE).
* Build executive‑level relationships (CFO, Tax Director) and cultivate a trusted‑advisor profile through insights on regulatory developments and market trends.



 People leadership 
 


* Lead, coach, and develop high‑performing teams across grades; provide on‑the‑job training, formal feedback, and sponsorship; promote inclusion and psychological safety.
* Foster collaboration across service lines (TP, Deals, Legal, Audit, Consulting) to deliver integrated solutions and develop next‑generation leaders.



 Risk, ethics, and operations 
 


* Uphold the firm’s quality, independence, confidentiality, and information security standards; proactively manage engagement risks and escalation protocols.
* Ensure accurate WIP, billing, and cash collection; deliver profitable growth against targets.


**What You’ll Bring** 

**Qualifications and experience** 



* 12\+ years of relevant corporate/international tax experience, with significant time in a Big Four or leading law/consulting firm; strong UAE/GCC exposure required.
* Deep technical command of UAE Corporate Tax law and guidance.
* Proven track record leading large, multi‑jurisdictional engagements and managing senior client stakeholders.
* Demonstrable business development success, with experience originating and closing sizable advisory projects.
* Strong understanding of IFRS tax accounting (IAS 12\) and reporting for groups; familiarity with GloBE deferred tax, safe harbours, and data requirements will be an advantage.
* Experience with Revenue Authority interactions, audits, rulings/clarifications, and dispute strategies will be an advantage.



**Education and professional credentials** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Recognised tax/accounting qualification preferred (e.g., ADIT, CTA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent).
* Arabic language skills are advantageous; fluency in English is required.



**Technical and leadership competencies** 



* Expert written and oral communication, with the ability to translate complex rules into pragmatic, commercially grounded advice.
* Strong financial modelling and data literacy; ability to guide clients on tax data, systems, and controls, including Pillar Two data readiness.
* High judgment and negotiation skills; capable of defending positions and navigating regulatory dialogue.
* Inclusive leadership, team building, and coaching at scale; resilient under pressure with excellent project management discipline.



**Technology and data** 




 You are proficient with MS Office and tax compliance platforms, and familiar with data extraction and transformation for tax compliance and reporting. You are comfortable utilising and developing market leading tax technology to support your role and deliver value to our clients, including AI, automation and analytics. 
 


**How You’ll Make a Difference** 

 At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.  
 


**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC** 

 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job \- you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

**Job Title:** 
 Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high\-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.
   

  

 The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross\-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country\-based execution to a coordinated EMEA\-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI\-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day\-to\-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future\-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution.
* Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.
* Maintain strong alignment with country leadership, ensuring technical delivery supports each country in achieving its annual project targets while applying regional synergies and continuous improvements.
* Drive cross\-country collaboration and resource optimization, enabling flexible deployment of technical expertise across the region.
* Own regional technical capacity planning, forecasting, and utilization, leveraging data and AI\-driven insights.
* Oversee partner strategy and execution, including onboarding, performance management, and management alignment.
* Embed and scale the AI\-powered ARIES methodology across all technical delivery activities.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery quality, efficiency, resource utilization, and partner performance.
* Support country Professional Services Directors in achieving project success, while maintaining strong technical oversight.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including reusable assets, automation, and standardization of deliverables.
* Act as a senior stakeholder in customer engagements, supporting critical projects and ensuring delivery excellence.


**Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, or professional services leadership.
* Proven track record managing large\-scale, complex, multi\-country implementation programs.
* Strong background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation environments.
* Deep understanding of technical architectures, integration, and data platforms.
* Experience with resource management, forecasting, and operational optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation and drive standardization.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills in a matrix environment.
* Experience working with partners and external delivery ecosystems.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate vision into execution.
* Ability to travel internationally 60% of the time.


**Education and Training:**
* Relevant University technical Degree
* Proficiency in English


**Key Success Factors:**
* Improved delivery predictability and quality across EMEA
* Increased resource utilization and cross\-regional efficiency
* Strong partner performance and optimization
* Effective adoption of AI\-driven implementation practices
* Scalable and standardized technical delivery model across EMEA markets


**About InterSystems**
 InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next\-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit
 **InterSystems.com**

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent network, and works alongside the VP to close exhibition packages, sponsorship inventory, and feature areas. The role is the senior commercial operator on the AixEnergy team and is accountable for the Year 1 close and the Year 2 rebooking pipeline captured on\-site plus any additional AixEnergy edition launches.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Own the AixEnergy Asia 2026 exhibition and sponsorship pipeline end\-to\-end: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and contract close. Carry an individual revenue target and report progress weekly against the Revenue Pathway forecast.
 



 Open and convert priority accounts across hyperscalers, data centre operators, energy and utility companies, EPCs, industrial real estate developers, and AI infrastructure vendors. Build credible peer\-level relationships with senior commercial decision\-makers and convert verbal interest into signed contracts.
 



  





 Manage and grow the AixEnergy agent network. Set agent targets, brief on pricing and proposition, and quality\-control agent\-sourced leads before they enter the AixEnergy pipeline.
 



 Work on sponsorship sales to convert sponsorship inventory: title partner, strategic partners, theatre and feature sponsorships, and on\-site activations.
 



  





 Maintain Salesforce hygiene to dmg events standard: every opportunity logged, staged, weighted, and updated weekly. Provide accurate weekly forecasts to the VP and into the WSR (Weekly Sales Report) cadence, with clear flags on slipped, won, and at\-risk deals.
 



  





 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
 



 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
 



  





 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
 



  





**Job Context:**




 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. The Commercial Director is joining at a critical phase of the cycle and is expected to close the gap to budget through direct sales, agent activation, and conversion of the existing pipeline. The event is co\-located with Gastech 2026 in Bangkok but operates as a standalone product with its own P\&L, exhibition, sponsorship inventory, and conference. The Commercial Director reports to the VP ADIPEC \& Business Development and works alongside the Operations Director, the Marketing Director and the Head of Content. The role requires a senior operator capable of working independently in an early\-stage commercial environment, holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale and energy executives, and delivering against a hard September 2026 close.
 



  





**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills:**




 Technical / Functional: Minimum 7 years senior B2B exhibition and sponsorship sales experience, with a track record of personally carrying and delivering revenue targets in excess of US$1m. Demonstrable success selling at a senior, peer\-level into AI infrastructure, data centres, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Experience launching first\-edition events strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM is essential. Familiarity with ASEAN markets, particularly Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, is an advantage. Experience working with sales agents and channel partners. Understanding of how exhibition, sponsorship, and conference content combine into a single commercial proposition. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
 



  





 Personal Attributes / Interpersonal: Senior commercial presence; comfortable holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale procurement leads, energy company executives, and EPC commercial directors. Closer’s instinct: identifies the path to contract early and drives the deal to signature. Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate effectively in a launch\-phase environment without established processes or large team support. Resilient under pressure; comfortable with hard targets, weekly forecast scrutiny, and a non\-negotiable September 2026 close. Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy. Collaborative across Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance; treats the pipeline as a shared commercial asset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willing to travel internationally as required, including to Bangkok ahead of and during the September 2026 event.
 



  





**dmg events is an equal opportunity employer. If you have not had feedback from us within 14 days, please consider your application as unsuccessful for this round.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To lead the design and continuous improvement of seamless, user\-centred customer journeys across all touchpoints and channels. This role ensures that every stage of the customer experience is intuitive, efficient, and aligned with the company’s service standards and strategic goals. By applying design thinking and data driven insights, the Manager — Customer Experience Design drives initiatives that enhance satisfaction, foster loyalty, and strengthen the brand’s reputation for excellence in customer care.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Customer Experience Design \& Innovation** 



* Lead the creation and maintenance of detailed customer journey maps and service blueprints for key customer segments.
* Apply design thinking methodologies to identify pain points and develop innovative solutions that simplify and enhance customer interactions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., IT, Marketing, Operations) to implement design solutions that align with digital transformation and business goals.
* Develop prototypes (UI/ UX) screens, test concepts with end\-users, and iterate designs based on feedback and data insights.



  





**Customer Insights \& Measurement** 



* Analyse qualitative and quantitative customer feedback to inform design priorities and validate experience improvements.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for journey effectiveness, including customer satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and journey friction points.
* Regularly present insights and design recommendations to senior management.



  





**People Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor team members to build strong design and customer empathy capabilities.
* Set clear performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and support professional development to maximize team effectiveness.
* Foster a collaborative culture of innovation and continuous improvement.



  





**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting** 



* Ensure compliance with information security and privacy requirements in all design initiatives.
* Adhere to and champion company policies, processes, and standards to maintain consistent and high\-quality service delivery.
* Prepare timely and accurate reports on journey performance, project progress, and design impact for leadership review.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to enhance departmental tools, methodologies, and best practices in line with global CX design trends.
* Lead or contribute to projects that drive service excellence and operational efficiency.



  





**Other Duties** 



* Perform other responsibilities related to the role as assigned by the Director — Customer Experience.



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 




**Minimum Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business or relevant field
* MBA is a preference



  





**Minimum Experience and Skills** 



* At least 5 years of experience in customer experiences related field.
* Multi\-disciplinary with excellent understanding of all touchpoints in the customer lifecycle.
* Ability to collaborate with multiple teams (e.g., Marketing, IT, external partners).
* Familiar with designing UI/UX screens on Figma or any other similar tool.
* Familiar with running customer focus groups and designing customer satisfaction surveys.
* Proven ability to apply customer\-centric design methods, strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading international consumer organisation undergoing a significant phase of operational evolution and regional transformation across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
 



  





 This appointment represents a strategically critical leadership hire, responsible for shaping and embedding a future\-ready operational model capable of supporting long\-term regional growth, scalability, efficiency, and commercial agility across diverse and evolving markets.
 



  





 Operating at Executive Committee level, the role will lead the transition and centralisation of key operational capabilities into Dubai, redefining how the organisation structures, governs, and executes operations across the region.
 



  





 This is not a traditional supply chain leadership position. It is a broad operational transformation mandate focused on organisational design, operating model evolution, infrastructure optimisation, and cross\-functional integration across complex international markets.
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



  





 The Director of Operational Transformation will be responsible for architecting and executing a large\-scale operational transformation agenda across MEA \& Asia.
 



 The successful individual will act as a strategic partner to regional and global leadership, driving the redesign of operational frameworks, improving organisational capability, enhancing supply network effectiveness, and establishing scalable infrastructure aligned with the organisation’s long\-term ambitions.
 



 The role requires a leader capable of balancing strategic vision with operational execution, while operating effectively across both mature and emerging markets.
 



 This individual will play a central role in influencing how the organisation evolves operationally over the coming years.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategic Operational Transformation
 


* Define and execute a regional operational transformation roadmap aligned with business growth objectives and long\-term organisational priorities
* Lead the redesign and optimisation of the regional operating model across operational functions
* Drive the transition and centralisation of operational capabilities into Dubai, ensuring effective governance, scalability, and regional alignment
* Partner closely with Executive Committee stakeholders to shape strategic operational priorities and long\-term capability development
* Evaluate current operational structures, identify inefficiencies, and implement future\-focused solutions to enhance agility and performance



 Operating Model \& Infrastructure Development
 


* Design scalable operational frameworks capable of supporting multi\-market growth across MEA \& Asia
* Establish governance structures, decision\-making frameworks, and operational standards across regional markets
* Develop integrated operational ecosystems connecting planning, logistics, procurement, distribution, customer operations, and commercial functions
* Support the evolution of regional hub structures, shared service capabilities, and centralised operational functions
* Lead organisational alignment initiatives to ensure operational structures support both regional and local market needs



 Supply Chain, Logistics \& Distribution Transformation
 


* Oversee the transformation and optimisation of regional supply chain and distribution networks
* Drive operational excellence initiatives across warehousing, transportation, inventory management, and fulfilment operations
* Evaluate and redesign logistics infrastructure and 3PL operating models to improve service levels, responsiveness, and cost efficiency
* Establish operational KPI frameworks to monitor service performance, operational efficiency, and network effectiveness
* Drive automation and digital enablement initiatives to improve operational visibility, planning capability, and execution consistency



 Procurement, Partnerships \& External Ecosystems
 


* Lead the development of strategic operational partnerships across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, and external service providers

**Company:** 
 Techne Agency

 Dubai (Managing a UK team) / Hybrid or Remote (with travel when required)

 Full\-Time

 Q3 2026
 



  





**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

This is a senior leadership position that requires deep experience in digital lending or financial services delivery, strong technology and operational fluency, and the ability to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-growing, regulated environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will demonstrate expertise in managing and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing comprehensive project plans, allocating resources efficiently, overseeing budgets, and excelling in risk management. He/she must have the skills to effectively manage multiple projects (initiatives, change requests) along with their dependencies and stakeholder engagements. Additionally, the candidate should possess strong analytical skills and the ability to compile and analyze projects (be familiar with Jira, Confluence, MS\-project, MS\-office).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategic Delivery \& Programme Leadership:
   

  

* Own the delivery of the enterprise roadmap, ensuring alignment with the COO, Commercial and Technology teams.
* Lead planning, execution and delivery of new projects and major programmes such as new product launches, regulatory changes, platform enhancements, change requests and market expansions.
* Oversee projects across cross\-functional technical and business streams for end\-to\-end delivery, fostering a collaborative work environment, ensuring effective communication and synergy among team members.
* Ensure programmes are fully scoped, resourced, risk\-assessed, and tracked through to completion.
* Provide clear status reporting, dependency management, and decision frameworks to senior leadership.
* Own the prioritisation forum, process and governance alongside resource planning and allocation.
* Customize, utilize and maintain Jira to create dynamic project dashboards, providing real\-time visibility into project status, progress, and key metrics that meet project and stakeholder requirements, incorporating analytical insights.


 Project \& Portfolio Management
   

  

* Develop a structured delivery framework (Agile/Hybrid/Waterfall) suitable for the company’s product and regulatory environment.
* Manage the project portfolio, prioritising initiatives based on strategic value, risk, resource availability, and ROI.
* Ensure robust project governance, documentation, and control processes are in place.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Data, Compliance, and Commercial teams to coordinate programme execution.
* Facilitate cross\-departmental alignment on requirements, timelines, decision points, and resource planning.
* Act as a key escalation point for conflicting priorities, blockers, or delivery risks.


 Operational Readiness \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Ensure that new features, products, and system changes are ready for operational deployment, with adequate testing, training, risk assessment, and support structures.
* Oversee UAT, release management, and change control processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery workflows, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.


 Risk, Compliance \& Regulatory Alignment
   

  

* Ensure delivery processes incorporate relevant regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., FCA, consumer credit, data protection, lending rules).
* Maintain strong risk identification, mitigation, and reporting across all delivery initiatives.
* Collaborate with Risk, Banking partners and Compliance teams to ensure regulatory changes are implemented correctly and on time.


 Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Lead and mentor a high\-performing team of project managers, functional / delivery leads and PMO staff.
* Build capability within the team through coaching, training, and structured development frameworks.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and excellence in execution.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelors in Business / Computer science / Engineering / MBA (or equivalent)
* 10\+ years’ experience in project, programme, or delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in financial services, lending, fintech, or credit\-platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the full lending lifecycle (originations, underwriting, credit decisioning, servicing, collections).
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, cross\-functional technology programmes.
* Deep knowledge of project management methodologies and tools (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Lean).
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, including at C\-suite and board level.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking capability.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a highly regulated environment.
* Previous responsibility for PMO leadership, Programme Management or portfolio/project governance.
* Experience with SaaS lending platforms, decision engines, or orchestration tools.
* Certifications such as Prince2, PMP, Agile PM, Scrum Master, or equivalent.
* Exposure to data\-driven decisioning, machine learning credit models, or digital onboarding journeys.


**The Ideal Candidate Is Someone Who**
* Thinks strategically with strong operational discipline.
* Is highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programmes.
* Leads with presence with the ability to drive clarity in ambiguous environments.
* Has a delivery\-focused mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Inspires through collaboration, adopting pragmatic and solutions\-oriented ideas.
* Has high integrity and sound judgement in a regulated context.


**Company Overview**
 Ezra provides B2B digital lending solutions for emerging markets in partnership with mobile and digital wallet operators and financial service providers. Ezra supports 24 operations in 23 countries, across Africa, the Middle East and Asia. Our key office locations are in Nairobi, Kenya and Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 Our flagship products are Airtime Credit Services (ACS), Nano and BNPL.
   

  

* ACS is an airtime or data advance offered to prepaid mobile subscribers at the point of low credit.
* Nano is a micro cash advance offered to mobile wallet users on demand.
* BNPL facilitates payment installments for products and services


 As a FinTech company, our business is entirely technology and data driven, from determining subscriber eligibility, generating relevant offers, managing risk, loan issuance, recovery, optimizing performance and reporting, reconciliation and billing.
   

  

 Each day we process approximately 21M loan requests and 1\.4 TB of data across our markets. This process needs to be robust, reliable and secure.
   

  

 But it doesn’t end there. We’re exploring new ways of using our platform and transactional data to improve our products and develop new product opportunities.

data.jd_text:
The Data Cleansing Program Director leads the Government\-Wide data cleansing program — driving large\-scale data quality uplift across multiple government entities. You will own the cleansing strategy, orchestrate a multi\-vendor delivery model, oversee enterprise data modelling, and ensure that cleansed datasets are published into the Government\-Wide catalogue and sharing platforms — sustainably, with strong governance, ongoing monitoring, and continuous improvement.
   

  

* Define and lead the Government\-Wide data cleansing strategy aligned with data quality standards, policies, and government priorities
* Establish a structured framework to prioritize critical datasets and drive phased execution across entities
* Standardize, automate, and scale the end\-to\-end data cleansing lifecycle — leveraging advanced tools and AI\-driven solutions; govern reusable accelerators
* Establish and oversee a multi\-vendor delivery model — coordinated execution, performance management, and scalability across entities
* Oversee large\-scale data quality improvement initiatives aligned to defined quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds
* Oversee development of entities' enterprise data models — aligned with Government\-Wide data standards, central information models, and interoperability requirements
* Ensure creation, standardization, and publication of cleansed datasets into the Government\-Wide data catalogue and sharing platforms — enabling accessibility and reuse
* Oversee development of data quality dashboards to track KPIs and cleansing progress
* Establish and lead program governance bodies — driving timely, quality delivery, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment
* Establish and govern sustainable data quality and cleansing frameworks for long\-term maintenance and continuous improvement
* Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on program progress, risks, and impact on data maturity and value realization


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Data Management, IT, Engineering, or related field
* 20\+ years in data management, data quality, or large\-scale transformation programs (preferably with exposure in Europe or North America)
* Proven track record leading enterprise\-wide or national data cleansing / data quality initiatives, including multi\-vendor delivery models
* Strong expertise in data quality frameworks, profiling, and remediation techniques
* Familiarity with modern data platforms — Informatica, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar
* Demonstrated experience managing large vendor ecosystems and complex multi\-stakeholder programs
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills at senior government or enterprise level
* Excellent English communication; Arabic a plus

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness


**Role Context**
 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.
* Understand manufacturing business, people management, supply chain management, financial management, quality management, and innovation.
* Possess experience in middle or senior management minimum of 10\-15 years.


**Job\-Specific Skills**
* Communication
* Values and respects others, Building relationships, Teamwork
* Process Loss Elimination Techniques
* Continuous improvement
* Project Management
* Creative Thinking
* Change Innovation
* Develops others
* Builds successful teams, Supports \& coaches the team
* Consulting skills
* Visionary leadership
* Achieving results, Customer driven
* Critical decision making
* Develops organisation budgets
* Organizational safety
* Financial astuteness
* Broad experience of developing and implementing short to long\-range objectives and strategies to achieve business goals.
* Proven capability of operating successfully at a senior management level.
* Understanding of electrical mechanical design engineering, competence in electrical power engineering.
* Demonstrate financial acumen including planning and cost control capabilities and proven experience of managing projects to budget.
* Proven track record in delivering manufacturing and supply chain best practice
* Strong working ethic in the delivery of satisfying the profitable requirements and expectations of internal and external customers.
* Effectively recognise and manage conflict
* Broad experience of working in a multi\-national, matrix organisation.
* Strong communications and presentation skills.
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Creates strong team \& guiding partner
* Promotes team accountability \& strong sense of understanding
* Is always curious \& goes beyond obvious
* Finds useful benchmarks \& does effective research
* Is open and candid about work situation
* Acts in a manner consistent with values
* Targets new opportunities \& sets clear objectives
* Commits to continuous improvement
* Expresses positive attitude toward teamwork
* Collects wisdom by sharing experiences and goals
* Provides task\-orientated and helpful instructions
* Provides behavioural feedback, coaching
* Facilitates open communications
* Proactively acts to gain customer trust
* Sees connections, relations, trends and patterns
* Applies learned concepts and think of new so to create a circle of learning.

**Manatal** 
 is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital.
 



 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Drive Technical Excellence:** 
 Lead major technical initiatives, ensuring architectural soundness, scalability, and long\-term impact.
* **Own Delivery:** 
 Oversee full project lifecycles from design to deployment with a focus on speed, quality, and reliability.
* **Release Management:** 
 Run a predictable release process with progressive delivery, clear rollout and rollback strategies, and strong operational readiness.
* **Platform Ownership:** 
 Own the AWS and Kubernetes platform end\-to\-end, including reliability, security, performance, and cost.
* **Hands\-On Execution:** 
 Stay close to the work by writing code, reviewing PRs, debugging production issues, and improving core services when needed.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Design, standardize, and maintain Terraform\-managed environments and operational best practices.
* **CI/CD and Velocity:** 
 Own CI/CD pipelines, improve build and deploy reliability, reduce lead time, and remove friction from the developer workflow.
* **Observability and Reliability:** 
 Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and SLO\-driven reliability practices.
* **On\-Call Leadership:** 
 Build and manage on\-call rotations, incident response, escalation paths, and postmortems with clear follow\-ups.
* **Technical Standards:** 
 Set and enforce engineering standards for architecture, code quality, security, and operational discipline.
* **Team Leadership:** 
 Mentor and develop engineers, create ownership, and keep priorities clear and execution under control.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Partner with Product and other stakeholders to align platform work with business goals and delivery commitments.



**Qualifications** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Director of Platform Engineering with the qualifications below. Each requirement is mandatory for this role:
 


* **Software Engineering Background:** 
 8\+ years building and operating production web applications and systems.
* **Platform Engineering Background:** 
 5\+ years owning AWS and Kubernetes in production, including reliability, security, and cost control.
* **Hands\-On Leadership:** 
 Regularly designs, implements, debugs, and reviews code and infrastructure, and can execute independently when needed.
* **Startup Mindset:** 
 Thrives in fast\-moving startups, takes ownership, works hard when needed, and brings high energy with a bias for action.
* **Infrastructure as Code Experience:** 
 Proven Terraform ownership across multiple environments, including networking, compute, and access controls.
* **Delivery and Releases:** 
 Owns CI/CD pipelines, release processes, progressive rollouts, and rollback strategies to keep deployments fast and safe.
* **Observability Stack:** 
 Has implemented and operated monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards with Datadog and/or Prometheus/Grafana.
* **On\-Call Operations:** 
 Build, manage and run on\-call rotations, incident response, and postmortems, and is willing to be on\-call when required.
* **Execution Focus:** 
 Sets clear priorities, protects development velocity, and keeps platform work under control.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Communicates clearly and directly, and collaborates effectively across engineering and product.
* **English Fluency:** 
 Fluent in spoken and written English for high\-stakes technical discussions.
* **Relocation Readiness:** 
 Based in Bangkok or willing to relocate and work in a multicultural team.



**Working with Manatal** 



* This role is based at our Bangkok office in the heart of the city center
* As a team of diverse cultures and nationalities, English language proficiency is required
* We enjoy collaborating in person, and the team is working on\-site



**Why you'll enjoy working with Manatal** 



* Well\-funded start\-up backed by Surge \& Sequoia
* Be part of one of the fastest\-growing B2B SaaS start\-ups in the region
* You will be collaborating with talented individuals in the industry
* Join a lively and highly international team
* Indulge in a challenging and innovative working culture
* Attractive medical healthcare plan

**What We're All About.**

Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We're made up of people from 60\+ nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
   

  

 If our incredible culture sounds like you, we'd love you to join us.
   

  

**The opportunity.**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end\-to\-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
   

  

 You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
   

  

 As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.

* You'll drive successful outcomes \- delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T\&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.
* Working and learning with a high degree of autonomy with minimal supervision, seeking and knowing when to engage the rest of the Quantexa organisation for support.
* You will devise critical strategies to successfully manage your project stakeholders, both from the client as well as Quantexa leadership.


**Requirements**

* Exhibit strong technical communication skills with demonstrable experience of working in rapidly changing client environments.
* Have an excellent appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.
* You are a self\-starter and bring a great deal of determination, initiative and tenacity to your projects.
* Proficiency in speaking Arabic at a fluent/native level is mandatory

* Have worked on a variety of complex data orientated projects for financial services, government, and telco clients

**Our perks and quirks.**
 What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* Competitive salary

* Private Healthcare with Daman, including dental \& optic cover

Heading in one direction \- the future.
   

  

**It's All About You.**
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected—because it's your individuality and passion that make you
 *Q*

data.jd_text:
Project London is looking for a Senior Architect to join our Dubai studio as we continue to grow our presence in the UAE.
 



  





 You must be based in Dubai
 



  





 We are a London founded architecture, interiors and project management studio, now bringing the same level of process, detail, commercial rigour and client care to Dubai. Our work is primarily high end private residential, including villas, apartments, bespoke new builds, refurbishments and full interior led transformations.
 



 This is a senior role for someone who can combine strong design judgement with technical competence, site confidence and the ability to manage projects properly from concept through to completion. We are looking for someone who understands that good architecture is not just about beautiful images. It is about clear thinking, proper coordination, robust detailing, buildability, budget awareness and protecting the client’s interests throughout.
 



  





 The Role
 



 The Senior Architect will take responsibility for leading architectural design and technical delivery across a range of private residential projects in Dubai. You will work closely with the Director in Dubai, as well as our interiors, project management and procurement teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers and client teams.
 



 You will be expected to manage projects with confidence, communicate clearly and bring order to complex design and construction processes. The right person will be comfortable working both in the studio and on site, and will have the experience to spot issues before they become problems.
 



 As Project London UAE grows, this role will offer genuine involvement in shaping how the studio operates, how projects are delivered and how we set standards in the Dubai market.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead architectural design packages from early concept through to detailed design and construction information.
 



 Prepare and oversee drawings, specifications, schedules and technical documentation.
 



 Develop layouts, spatial planning, elevations, sections, details and coordinated design packages.
 



 Coordinate with interior designers, MEP consultants, structural engineers, landscape designers, contractors and suppliers.
 



 Review consultant and contractor information to ensure quality, accuracy and alignment with the design intent.
 



 Support authority and developer approval processes, including Emaar, Dubai Municipality, Trakhees and relevant community or master developer requirements.
 



 Attend site meetings and carry out site inspections to review workmanship, progress and compliance with the drawings.
 



 Identify design, technical and coordination risks early and propose practical solutions.
 



 Assist with tender documentation, contractor queries and technical clarifications.
 



 Support project managers with programme, sequencing, cost control and client reporting.
 



 Maintain high standards of drawing presentation, technical accuracy and file organisation.
 



 Represent Project London professionally with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 Degree in Architecture or equivalent professional qualification.
 



 Minimum 8 to 10 years’ professional experience, ideally with at least some UAE or GCC project experience.
 



 Strong experience in high end residential architecture.
 



 Excellent technical detailing and construction knowledge.
 



 Confident working across concept design, technical design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Good understanding of Dubai authority, developer and community approval processes.
 



 Strong AutoCAD skills are essential.
 



 Confident on site and comfortable challenging contractors when required.
 



 Strong coordination skills across architecture, interiors, MEP, structure and specialist suppliers.
 



 Excellent written and spoken English.
 



 Highly organised, proactive and commercially aware.
 



 Able to manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of detail.
 



 A calm, professional manner with clients and project teams.
 



  





 The Person
 



 We are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly. Someone who can bring design sensitivity, technical rigour and a steady hand to fast moving projects.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a growing studio environment, where everyone contributes and where standards matter. This is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind drawings. We need someone who can think, communicate, coordinate and take responsibility.
 



 You will suit the role if you are:
 



 Practical as well as creative.
 



 Detail focused without losing sight of the bigger picture.
 



 Comfortable with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



 Able to bring calm and clarity to complex situations.
 



 Interested in raising standards in the Dubai residential market.
 



  





 Why Join Project London
 



 This is an exciting opportunity to join Project London UAE at an early stage of its growth, while being backed by an established London studio with a strong reputation in high end residential architecture, interiors and project delivery.
 



 You will work closely with the Director in Dubai and have real involvement in the development of the studio, the way projects are delivered, and the standards we set as we grow. This is not a role where you will disappear into a large corporate structure. You will be close to the decision making, close to the clients and close to the work itself.
 



 We are building something carefully in Dubai, not chasing volume for the sake of it. The aim is to deliver exceptional private residential projects with the same rigour, attention to detail and client care our London clients expect.
 



 For the right person, this is a chance to help shape a growing studio, contribute meaningfully from day one and be part of a business with genuine ambition in the UAE market.
 



  





 Package
 



 Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
 



 Full time role based in Dubai.
 



 Immediate or early start preferred.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please send your CV, portfolio and answers to the questions below to:
 



 sm@projectlondon.co.uk
 



 Subject line
 



 Senior Architect Application, Dubai
 



 We would particularly like to see examples of residential projects where you have been involved in technical design, coordination and site delivery, not just concept imagery.
 



  





 Application Questions
 



 Please answer the following four questions when applying. 
 **Anyone who does not answer all four questions will not be considered.** 



1. **Please summarise your relevant experience and explain why you believe you would be a strong fit for this Senior Architect role at Project London UAE. Please include the types of projects you have worked on, your level of responsibility and what you would bring to the team.**
2. **Please describe one completed residential project where you were responsible for taking the design from concept through to technical detailing, tender or site delivery. What was your role, what were the main challenges and what did you personally resolve?**
3. **In Dubai, residential projects often involve tight coordination between architecture, interiors, MEP, structure, authority approvals, contractors and suppliers. Please give an example of where you identified a coordination issue before it became a site problem. How did you handle it?**
4. **Please attach or link to one drawing package, detail sheet or technical example that best represents your own work. Briefly explain what you personally produced and why it demonstrates your suitability for this role.**

 In an administrative role at Kuehne\+Nagel, tasks such as managing office operations or coordinating schedules certainly contribute to your team's success, but they also provide meaningful moments for people around the world.  ‎

The EBDM reports directly to the Global Head of Project Logistics Energy.No team reports into this position; it is an individual contributor role with significant strategic impact.
   

  

 The EBDM is responsible for generating new business opportunities across all segments of the Oil \& Gas value chain, developing a strong pipeline within defined markets, and analysing market potential and competitive dynamics to prioritize opportunities aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with global and regional stakeholders, the Energy Business Development Manager builds customer relationships based on trust, expertise, and innovation, ensuring the right internal and external partners are engaged at the right time to secure new projects.
   

  

 This role requires a professional who exemplifies strong Compliance and HSE standards, demonstrates strategic thinking, and thrives in a customer‑centric, high‑impact environment.

**What we would like you to bring**

* Strong understanding of the Oil \& Gas value chain and major project cycles, including tendering and contract negotiation.

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact within Kuehne\+Nagel by shaping major Energy and Project Logistics developments, working in an international and collaborative environment, gaining visibility with global leadership, and benefiting from a culture that values ownership, innovation, and professional growth.

 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
