data.jd_text:
At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
   

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible**
 Job Description and Qualifications
   

  

 Rotoflow™, an Air Products Business, is a full\-service turbomachinery OEM \- providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and services to our customers globally in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Aftermarket services such as spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services are some of the many offerings provided from regional service centers for both Air Products and non\-Air Products equipment.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Rotoflow** 
**Aftermarket Project Manager** 
 at our turbomachinery service center in KSA\- DSC, responsible for providing projects execution with engineering support for spare parts, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery.
   

  

**You Will Enjoy**
* Be part of a team to grow a world\-class service and machinery business.
* Seeing the results of candidate’s direct efforts through successful execution of customer projects.
* Being empowered to satisfy customers and have influence on changes to work processes to meet customer expectations on speed and world\-class customer service.
* Collaborating with a cross\-functional team across commercial, engineering, procurement and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope.
* Significant direct interaction with customers, in coordination with account managers, ensures Rotoflow exceeds customer expectations with solutions.
* Ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.


**Responsibilities**
* Work collaboratively with Proposal Managers to receive assigned orders, develop and implement appropriate execution plans that address execution, budget, and schedule, and put in place a team that can successfully execute.
* Manage and execute orders and projects concurrently in different phases, from order intake, execution, shipment, invoicing, and accounts receivable.
* Maximize revenue recognition and take necessary actions to fill the (planned vs actual) gaps.
* Ensure regular communication is provided to internal and external stakeholders and customers on the status of projects and develop relationships that will indirectly drive and boost sales.
* Lead and guide the execution team and provide directions on objective priorities to ensure tasks and deliverables are completed as planned.
* Manage changes on projects to keep projects on track and meet financial and customer targets.
* Provide feedback on lessons learned during execution to other functions to assure continuous improvement.


**Qualifications And Requirements**
* Technical Degree (BA/BS/BEng); mechanical/ Industrial engineering background a plus,
* Project Management Experience, \> 5 years is preferred, with excellent written and oral communication skills and demonstrated ability to effectively lead and organize engineering teams and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* PMP certification is preferred.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP is beneficial
* Detailed knowledge of rotating equipment's / turbomachinery, accessory systems, and related technologies and services is a plus.
* Goal oriented, self\-motivated, highly organized, with ability to drive success, with strong winning spirit and ability to motivate teams.
* Excellent creativity, problem solving, and decision\-making skills \- including an understanding of when to escalate both technical and administrative decisions.
* Aptitude and desire to quickly learn.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Ability and drive to continuously improve and eliminate unnecessary barriers or complexity to meeting customer needs
* Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.


 We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end\-to\-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
   

  

 At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visit About Air Products.

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and oversee various energy sector projects, ensuring their successful delivery within scope, budget, and timeline. This role involves managing project teams, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation to achieve project objectives.

* Lead and manage the entire project lifecycle from initiation to closure, including planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure activities.

* Identify and manage project risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Manage project budgets, tracking expenditures, and ensuring financial targets are met.
* Oversee procurement processes for project materials and services.
* Conduct post\-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices for future projects.
* Prepare and present project reports, presentations, and documentation to senior management and clients.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**
* A bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering is required.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in project management, preferably within the energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6\).

* Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and geographically dispersed team environment.

 Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, powering a sustainable energy future through innovative power grid technologies with digital at the core. Over three billion people depend on our technologies to power their daily lives.
   

  

 With over a century in pioneering mission\-critical technologies like high\-voltage, transformers, automation, and power electronics, we are addressing the most urgent energy challenge of our time – balancing soaring electricity demand, while decarbonizing the power system.
   

  

 Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 50,000 people in 60 countries and generate revenues of around $16 billion USD. We welcome you to apply today.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To drive the delivery of a risk\-based Technology Audit portfolio, providing strategic assurance and insights that strengthen IT governance, controls, and business performance. The role leads complex technology audit engagements standalone or integrated with business audits, develops high\-performing teams, fosters collaboration, and ensures the Internal Audit function adds measurable value to organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Technology Audit and Advisory Delivery** 




  




* Supports with the technology component of a risk\-based IA plan by coordinating and managing the delivery of the IT risk assessment and annual planning activities. This involves proposing audit engagements for inclusion in IA plans, including the scope, timing, and required resources.
* Acts as the Engagement Manager\* for multiple or large integrated audit engagements concerning technology audit areas within the IA Department. Responsible for the day\-to\-day project management of the engagements across planning, fieldwork and reporting, ensuring delivery of high\-quality assurance and advice, on time and within allocated budget.
* Establishes and maintains regular coordination between the IA Director (or Executive Director), management and the engagement team on the
* progress of engagements, ensuring corrective actions are taken to address any identified issues impacting the engagement plan.
* Regularly monitors and reports on the progress of management action plans, facilitating the effective and timely implementation of management action plans. This involves guiding action owners (where necessary), challenging revised due dates, escalating overdue actions and managing the verification of closed actions.
* Supports and coach engagement teams throughout the engagement lifecycle, to facilitate the correct application of the IA methodology, and enhances the teams’ functional and leadership competencies.
* Supports the VP, Internal, IA Director (or Executive Director) with the delivery of their role, as delegated.
* Ensure delivery of high\-impact, risk\-based audits that enhance control effectiveness and strengthen control environment and organizational governance.



  





**IT Governance Framework, ERP and Data Analytics** 



* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, ITIL etc.), ensuring alignment with organizational policies, regulatory expectations, and risk‑management objectives.
* Assess ERP environments (SAP S/4 Hana etc.) for configuration adequacy, access controls, change‑management practices, and process integrity across key business cycles.
* Perform technology risk assessments to identify control gaps, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues within core IT processes and enterprise applications.
* Leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Python) to perform automated testing, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and continuous\-monitoring routines.
* Develop sound audit findings and recommendations that strengthen IT controls, improve system performance, and enhance data reliability, while collaborating with stakeholders across IT, finance, and operations.



  





**Leadership** 



* Plans, manages, and reviews team performance to monitor achievement of key performance indicators.
* Provides timely feedback, coaching, and development to strengthen team capabilities.
* Proposes and implements initiatives aligned with the IA strategic direction.
* Leads or supports IA strategic initiatives and advocates for positive change in work practices.
* Build a high\-performing, future\-ready IA team aligned with strategic business goals.



  





**Quality \& Operations** 



* Ensures QAIP feedback is addressed effectively to enhance engagement quality and team capability.
* Promotes adherence to quality standards across all IA activities.
* Supports continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process enhancements and best practices.
* Drive culture of continuous improvement and excellence in audit execution.



  





**Business Partnering** 



* Builds and maintains strong client relationships to stay informed and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Develops cross\-functional relationships across TAQA to enable knowledge sharing within IA and across TAQA.
* Supports Directors at portfolio\-level reporting and insights, as required.
* Strengthen IA’s role as a trusted advisor and strategic business partner.



  





**Collaboration \& IA Strategy** 



* Shares knowledge and expertise across the IA team to enhance capability and consistency.
* Collaborates with peers and other IA teams to optimize resource use and deliver quality outcomes.
* Constructively challenges peers to enhance performance
* Recognize and celebrate collaborative behavior.
* Leverages IA Operations support to minimize administrative workload and improve efficiency.
* Foster collaborative, high\-performing culture that drives collective IA team success.
* Actively support in strategic initiatives implementation ensuring quality and timely completion of assigned tasks.



  





**Policies and Procedures** 



* Undertake all audit activities in line with IA’s policies and procedures.
* Ensure performed audit work comply with the pertinent internal audit P\&Ps and Global IIA Standards.
* Ensures consistent compliance for all assigned audit activities, reinforcing the credibility and reliability of the Internal Audit Function.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Professional certification: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA),



 Certified Risk and Information System Controls (CRISC)
 



 Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
 



  





**Experience**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Reporting to Head Technical Training, the position of Electrical Instructor is involved in the preparation of curriculum, training manuals, and materials as well as the delivery of technical training to the designated employees and other company staff.
   

  

**Key Result Areas (All Roles)**
* Conduct training needs analysis (TNA) and develop appropriate training programs including but not limited to externally accredited Diploma \& Certificated courses.
* Assist in developing unit technology specific Lesson Plans and supplemental instructional materials to deliver required knowledge, skills and attitude among the trainees.
* Deliver competency based technical training relevant to electrical systems for all units, infrastructure, equipment, systems and subsystems in the BMP refinery to prepare Electricians for greenfield start up, current plant operations and future positions of the BMP.
* Administer and deliver consistent Unit specific assessment, instruction and validation to electrical trainees, including but not limited to Electrical needs for:
* Scheduled and preventative maintenance
* Shutdowns and turnarounds
* Reliability and condition monitoring
* Hazardous area training, classification and certification
* High voltage switching and associated equipment training
* Refresher Training
* Ascertain that all training solutions are developed to enhance employee competency to maintain electrical requirements for all process plants during normal, emergency, and shut down situations, safely and effectively.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of trainee's performance / progress and provide on the job support and guidance during and after the training event to ensure effective transfer of learning to the job.
* Follow Bapco’s strategic plan to provide effective provision of training closely aligned to the Competency Framework and OE processes.
* Evaluate and continuously update training courses to meet competency framework requirements and ensure that training solutions are in line with industry best practice.
* Acts independently regarding developing, scheduling and delivery with all associated in\-house communication.
* Establish and develop independent contacts with external suppliers as required and in developing training interventions for concerned departments to decide the most appropriate refresher and up skilling training requirements.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum of 7 years' work experience of which a minimum of 3 years preferably in developing, conducting, and administering training programs for Oil Refineries or large Process Industries.
* Certified Assessor / Internal Verifier for Competency Based Assessment is preferred.
* Should be trained as a technical instructor with the ability to deliver general plant and process engineering learning modules.
* Work experience in Oil \& Gas Industry, preferably petroleum refining.
* Must have broad experience and familiarity gained from a wide range of refinery process units. Such as: Electrical substations, HV motors, VSD, electrical generators, UPS and associated equipment.
* In\-depth knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models. Lesson and curriculum planning skills.
* Ability to write effective instructional text, audio and video scripts.
* A good understanding of learning management systems is beneficial.


**About Us**
 Bapco Energies operates a portfolio spanning the entire energy value chain in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The portfolio includes wholly\-owned subsidiaries and specialized operating companies. Together, these companies drive Bapco Energies' mission to power the next generation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Bapco Refining (with a legacy of being referred to as “The Company” in Arabic \- Ash Shariqa locally) is a trusted and enterprising organisation, which has never stood still since its inception. The first to discover oil in the Arabian peninsula in 1932, it started exporting crude in 1934, and installed the region’s first crude oil refinery in 1936\.
   

  

 Since then the Company has helped shape the modern Kingdom of Bahrain, not simply through the generation of wealth, but through its committed development of the people of Bahrain. The Company is known as the incubator of much of the leadership talent in Bahrain developed over many decades. Bapco Refining touches all aspects of life in the Kingdom.
   

  

 With a rich history of more than 85 years, the adventure continues with new ambitions and initiatives in the downstream sector as well as oil and gas field development. The most recent is the Company’s multi\-billion dollar expansion project which will significantly increase the Refinery’s capacity and employ the latest refining technology to meet future customer demands, latest fuels specifications and environmental compliance.
   

  

 Bapco Refining is engaged in the oil industry including refining and distribution of petroleum products, sales and exports of crude oil and refined products.

data.title: Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology
data.raw_snippet:
**Objective:**
 RCSI Bahrain is seeking to appoint a dynamic and clinically focused Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology to support the delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate medical education within the School of Medicine.
   

  

 Given the clinically integrated nature of the c
data.jd_text:
**Objective:**
 RCSI Bahrain is seeking to appoint a dynamic and clinically focused Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology to support the delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate medical education within the School of Medicine.
   

  

 Given the clinically integrated nature of the curriculum, the University is specifically seeking a medically qualified clinician with expertise in Infectious Diseases and/or Clinical (Medical) Microbiology. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clinically relevant microbiology teaching aligned to modern medical practice, patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship, infection prevention, and clinical decision\-making.
   

  

 The appointee will contribute to teaching, assessment, curriculum development, academic advising, and scholarly activity, while supporting the continued integration of microbiology across systems\-based and case\-based learning. The appointee will collaborate closely with the Department of Clinical Microbiology in RCSI Dublin, including participation in teaching and assessment meetings to ensure a coordinated and standardised approach to teaching and assessment across both campuses.
   

  

 Appointment may be made at Lecturer or Senior Lecturer level depending on qualifications, experience, academic profile, and leadership contribution.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Medicine or Nominee
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Teaching:**
 • Deliver high\-quality teaching in microbiology, infectious diseases, infection prevention, and antimicrobial stewardship across undergraduate programmes.
   

 • Contribute to integrated and clinically contextualised teaching within systems\-based and case\-based curricula.
   

 • Facilitate small\-group teaching, tutorials, laboratory interpretation sessions, clinical correlation sessions, and team\-based learning activities.
   

 • Support the development and delivery of clinically relevant microbiology practical and simulation activities.
   

 • Contribute to online and blended learning initiatives using the University’s digital learning platforms.
   

 • Participate in student assessment activities including question writing, OSCEs, practical examinations, standard setting, and moderation processes.
   

 • Participate in teaching and assessment meeting with the Dept of Clinical Microbiology, RCSI, Dublin
   

 • Provide academic mentorship and pastoral support to students.
   

 • Work collaboratively with clinical and basic science colleagues to ensure relevance and consistency of teaching delivery.
   

 • Contribute to curriculum planning, vertical integration, sequencing, and alignment of microbiology and infectious diseases teaching across the undergraduate programme.
   

 • Work collaboratively across disciplines including medicine, pathology, pharmacology, immunology, paediatrics, and public health to support integrated curriculum delivery.
   

 • Support clinically relevant microbiology practical teaching, simulation activities aligned to clinical practice.
   

  

**Research and Scholarship**
 • Contribute to scholarly activity, educational innovation, research, and/or clinical academic initiatives relevant to microbiology or infectious diseases.
   

 • Support student research, audits, quality improvement initiatives, and scholarly dissemination.
   

 • Develop collaborative links with clinical partners and healthcare institutions within Bahrain and wider region.
   

  

**Student Mentoring:**
 • Provide pastoral care, mentorship, and support in developing research projects to students
   

 • Participate in the Personal Tutor Program to support student well\-being and academic development.
   

  

**General:**
 • Participate in School and University committees, working groups, and academic governance activities.
   

 • Support quality assurance, accreditation, and regulatory activities as required.
   

 • Contribute to outreach, student recruitment, and community engagement initiatives.
   

 • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the grade of appointment.
   

 • Attend administrative and academic meetings relevant to clinical teaching.
   

 • Provide regular feedback to the Head of Department on program content and curriculum development and assist in implementing improvements where appropriate
   

 • Ensure that all RCSI Bahrain policies and procedures are adhered to
   

 • Participate in faculty development and medical education training activities as required.
   

 • Familiarises oneself with the RCSI Bahrain Virtual Learning Environment (VLE)
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**Personal Specifications:** 
  

  

 • Medical degree recognised for clinical practice.
   

 • Specialist qualification and/or board certification and/or FRCPath or equivalent in:
   

  

 o Infectious Diseases, and/or
   

 o Medical Microbiology, and/or
   

 o Clinical Microbiology.
   

  

 • Eligibility for professional registration/licensure in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
   

 • Experience delivering clinical microbiology / infectious diseases teaching.
   

 • Experience in assessment design, moderation, and standard setting.
   

 • Experience with case\-based or blended learning approaches.
   

 • Postgraduate qualification in medical education or ongoing faculty development activity is desirable.
   

 • Ability to deliver high\-quality teaching and educational activities within required timelines.
   

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
   

 • Ability to demonstrate initiative
   

 • Strong organisational and administrative skills

data.raw_snippet:

* Carry out specific maintenance tasks related to machine repairs, new machine commissioning, and validation activities.
* Assist the maintenance tea
data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
* Maintenance Execution
* Receive instructions from the Maintenance Unit Head/Manager for assigned maintenance tasks and projects.
* Carry out specific maintenance tasks related to machine repairs, new machine commissioning, and validation activities.
* Assist the maintenance team in troubleshooting breakdowns and performing preventive maintenance (PM) as required.
* Prepare designs for specific machine upgrades (electrical or mechanical) and submit them for management review and approval.
* Follow up on project execution after design approval.
* Clean and organize the working area upon task completion.
* Document task details, including timing, completion status, and any new observations/findings.
* Submit Repair Request Forms (RRF) for any pending tasks or additional issues found.
* Obtain feedback from production teams to ensure full resolution and satisfaction.
* Coordination \& Spare Parts Management
* Coordinate with the Maintenance Unit Head/Manager to ensure proper resource allocation for assigned projects.
* Coordinate with the Store regarding delivery of critical spare parts and escalate any delays.
* Prepare and submit Spare Parts Requisition Forms as needed.
* Data Analysis \& Improvement
* Analyze maintenance data, including repetitive breakdowns, delays in PM, and spare part consumption.
* Propose action plans and improvements based on analysis findings.
* Calibration \& External Services
* Execute in\-house calibration tasks as per instructions and defined Work Instructions (WI).
* Coordinate outsourced calibration activities with the Local Purchasing Unit (LPC).
* Ensure timely availability of external calibration agencies, oversee tasks, and follow up on calibration certificates.
* Update the Calibration Master File upon completion.
* Safety \& 5S Compliance
* Follow all NAPCO\-IFP safety procedures and attend all required safety meetings.
* Enforce company health and safety policies among the team and monitor for compliance.
* Carry out risk assessments and ensure emergency response protocols are understood by all personnel.
* Immediately report and act upon unsafe acts, conditions, or near\-misses.
* Participate in cross\-auditing and ensure adherence to the plant’s hazard control standards.
* Conduct daily safety talks in assigned work areas.
* Perform assigned 5S duties as per the 5S plan to maintain an efficient and safe work environment.
* Safety Responsibilities
* Enforce full compliance with health and safety procedures across the maintenance area.
* Understand and ensure all subordinates are trained on safe work practices.
* Identify unsafe conditions or behaviors and take immediate corrective action.
* Lock out any unsafe equipment until it is repaired and deemed safe.
* Actively participate in safety audits, emergency drills, and 5S implementation.
* Promote safety awareness among team members.
* Job Dynamics \& Interfaces


**Internal Interfaces**
* Maintenance Team
* Production Team
* Store \& Spare Parts Team
* Health \& Safety Department


**External Interfaces**
* Local Purchasing Unit (LPC)
* External Calibration Agencies
* Required Qualifications


**Education \& Experience**
* University degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (preferred).
* Strong reading, writing, and arithmetic skills.
* At least 2–4 years of experience in industrial maintenance or plant engineering roles.


**Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of maintenance techniques (mechanical and electrical).
* Ability to read machine manuals, technical diagrams, and work instructions.
* Familiarity with spare parts management and calibration procedures.
* Analytical skills for root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in documenting maintenance activities and reporting.
* Special Working Conditions
* Must be in good physical condition and able to work under pressure.
* Willingness to work alternating shifts.
* Must adhere to all local labor laws and NAPCO\-IFP safety policies.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an exceptional Finance Director to serve as the principal financial confidant and strategic adviser within a dynamic entrepreneur's Private Office. This is a rare, standalone appointment offering unparalleled direct access and genuine influence at the very centre of a high\-profile individual's business and personal financial world.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Embedded within the Private Office and reporting exclusively to the principal, you will serve as the financial backbone of a fast\-moving entrepreneurial operation — spanning a diverse portfolio of business interests, personal wealth, and investment assets including property and tangibles. This is not a corporate finance role. You will operate with full independence from all existing business lines, acting as the principal's most trusted financial voice: candid, proactive, and wholly aligned to his interests.
 



  





 You will be an exceptionally competent accountant and expected to think and act like a true business partner — anticipating needs, identifying risks and opportunities, and bringing genuine commercial instinct to every interaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the principal financial adviser across all private office matters, business interests, and personal wealth
* Own the consolidation and interpretation of financial data across a complex, multi\-entity portfolio — translating it into clear, actionable intelligence for the principal
* Provide proactive, commercially sharp advice on tax planning, cash management, and capital allocation
* Monitor performance across the portfolio, flagging issues and opportunities with candour and speed
* Oversee financial governance, reporting cadences, and controls appropriate to a private entrepreneurial structure
* Support deal evaluation, acquisitions, and new ventures as they arise — the principal moves quickly and expects his Finance Director to move with him
* Maintain absolute confidentiality and discretion across all matters at all times



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with substantial post\-qualification experience (min 10 years), ideally with exposure to private office, family office, or entrepreneurial environments
* A genuine entrepreneurial mindset — you thrive in ambiguity, move at pace, and are energised rather than unsettled by a principal who operates across multiple ventures simultaneously
* Proven experience providing financial counsel directly to a business owner, principal, or UHNW individual — not just reporting upwards within a large organisation
* Deep familiarity with complex, multi\-entity financial structures; comfortable across both corporate and personal financial matters
* Exceptional analytical capability combined with the judgement to know what matters and the confidence to say so plainly
* Outstanding interpersonal skills — this role demands a trusted relationship with a highly successful, highly demanding individual; you must be direct, reliable, and easy to work alongside
* Unimpeachable discretion; the handling of sensitive personal and commercial information is central to this role
* Self\-directing and highly organised — you will set your own agenda and be held accountable for outcomes, not activity

data.jd_text:
**Be An Essential Part Of Everyday Life**
 DHL Supply Chain is the world’s leading contract logistics provider that combines value\-added and management services with traditional fulfillment and distribution. At DHL Supply Chain we are committed to looking after tomorrow \& today with our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategy.
   

  

 So what's it like to work for DHL Supply Chain? At DHL we’re proud of our international reach as it brings together people with a wide range of skills, experiences, cultures, and viewpoints. We see the diversity of our employees as a genuine strength and we’re proud of our supportive work environment where employees are given the tools and training they need to learn, grow and succeed.
   

  

 We are offering an exciting opportunity for the position of Director Business Development in Saudi. Your role will be to lead assigned sales and accounts within the Technology, Automation and Energy (TAE) Sector, with a special focus on Technology.
   

  

 What will your responsibilities be?
   

  

  

* Lead DSC Business Development \& Account Development strategy to deliver significant growth in Saudi Arabia
* Develop a pro\-active sales plan engaging with the Marketing team and participate in relevant seminars/ conferences
* Build and leverage a strong network in Saudi Arabia to drive new business and support company growth objectives.
* Lead the team that will manage RFQs in Saudi Arabia coordinating the different roles and assembling/leading a winning wolf pack
* Close collaboration and active engagement with Chief Commercial Officer EMEA and the Sector Teams as well as other DHL sister divisions to drive further growth
* Lead the implementation of the assigned sales strategies coming from EMEA, Global, Corporate
* Main focus will be in TAE Sectors (Technology, Auto\-Mobility, Engineering \& Manufacturing, Energy, Chemicals)
* Ensure that all business initiatives are compliant with local laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia, including any relevant licensing or reporting requirements.
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes, market conditions, and economic indicators that may impact business strategy.
* Provide regular reports to senior management and stakeholders detailing progress, challenges, and future action plans.
* Manage and mentor a team of business development and sales professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture.
* Provide ongoing training, coaching, and development to ensure the team remains equipped with up\-to\-date market knowledge and skills.


 What do we need from you?
   

  

  

* Proven track record in Sales and Business Development in logistics, including warehousing \& transport
* Demonstrated success in developing and executing strategies that drive revenue growth in the Saudi market or broader Gulf region.
* Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to inspire and manage high\-performing teams.
* In\-depth understanding of the local business environment, market dynamics, and regulatory framework in Saudi Arabia.
* Excellent consultative selling skills and techniques (ACCELERATE Type)
* Proven ability to manage and influence in a matrix management environment
* Strong drive, resilience, and a proven track record in sales
* Fluency in English both written and spoken on the business level


 We look forward to your application!

data.jd_text:
SaaS Business Unit Manager
 



  





 Sales, Growth, Customer Success \& Operations
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We are an established technology company in Kuwait with several years of market experience, a growing base of more than 600 business customers, and strong relationships with leading local and international partners.
 



  





 The company operates in the business technology sector, providing software, SaaS, payment\-related solutions, hardware, and digital business tools for SMEs and enterprise clients. The SaaS business unit is already active in the market and is now entering a new growth stage that requires stronger structure, leadership, sales execution, customer success, and scalable operations.
 



  





 This is not a role to build something from zero. It is an opportunity to lead and scale an existing business line with real customers, proven demand, market credibility, and strong growth potential.
 



  





  





  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on SaaS Business Unit Manager to lead the growth and daily operations of our SaaS product in Kuwait.
 



  





 This is a key leadership role for someone who can combine B2B sales, growth execution, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support operations, team building, and process management.
 



  





 The right candidate will take ownership of the SaaS business unit and help build it into a scalable, well\-organized, and high\-growth operation.
 



  





  





**Why Join Us** 




  





 This is not a narrow sales or operations role. It is an opportunity to lead and grow a complete SaaS business unit with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, team structure, and market expansion.
 



  





 You will work closely with senior management, have clear ownership, and play a central role in building the company’s SaaS growth engine in Kuwait.
 



  





  





 1\. Role Objective
 



  





 Lead the full commercial and operational performance of the SaaS business unit, including sales, growth, marketing coordination, onboarding, customer success, technical support, team management, and daily execution.
 



  





 The goal is to build a scalable SaaS operation with clear ownership, structure, and measurable performance, allowing senior management to focus on strategic partnerships, major deals, and product development.
 



  





  





  





 2\. Sales \& Revenue
 



  





 Own sales targets, pipeline management, lead follow\-up, demos, closing activities, renewals, and revenue growth.
 



  





 Build and manage a structured sales process, improve conversion rates, train the sales team, and ensure full CRM discipline.
 



  





  





 3\. Growth \& Marketing
 



  





 Coordinate with marketing to generate qualified leads through campaigns, offers, content, landing pages, WhatsApp messages, and sector\-specific promotions.
 



  





 Measure marketing impact based on lead quality, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and revenue generated.
 



  





  





 4\. Customer Onboarding
 



  





 Manage the full onboarding journey from contract signing to go\-live.
 



  





 Create clear onboarding checklists, assign responsibilities, reduce activation delays, and ensure customers start using the system properly.
 



  





  





  





 5\. Customer Success \& Retention
 



  





 Ensure customer satisfaction, product adoption, renewals, upselling, and churn reduction.
 



  





 Monitor customer issues and usage patterns, identify at\-risk customers early, and build proactive follow\-up processes.
 



  





  





  





 6\. Technical Support Operations
 



  





 Organize daily technical support operations, ticket handling, issue classification, escalation rules, response time, and resolution follow\-up.
 



  





 Coordinate between customers, support staff, technical teams, and management to ensure fast and professional support.
 



  





  





  





 7\. Team Management
 



  





 Plan, hire, train, and manage the required sales, onboarding, customer success, and support teams.
 



  





 Set KPIs, monitor performance, improve discipline, and build a culture of accountability, teamwork, and customer service quality.
 



  





  





  





 8\. Operations \& Processes
 



  





 Build and improve SOPs for sales, onboarding, support, reporting, internal coordination, and customer follow\-up.
 



  





 Reduce operational chaos, dependency on individuals, and create a scalable operating system for the SaaS business.
 



  





  





  





 9\. Product \& Market Feedback
 



  





 Collect feedback from customers, sales, onboarding, and support teams.
 



  





 Organize product improvement requests and coordinate with the development/product team based on business impact, customer value, and scalability.
 



  





  





  





 10\. Reporting \& KPIs
 



  





 Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering sales, MRR, pipeline, onboarding, support, churn, renewals, complaints, team productivity, and operational risks.
 



  





 Track key KPIs including leads, demos, closed deals, conversion rate, onboarding time, support tickets, response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, and churn.
 



  





  





  





 11\. Authority \& Execution
 



  





 The manager has the authority to prepare business plans, growth plans, sales plans, operational plans, hiring needs, tools, systems, and required resources.
 



  





 Once approved by senior management, the manager has full authority and responsibility to execute the approved plan and manage daily operations within the approved scope.
 



  





  





  





 12\. Required Experience
 



  





 Strong experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, software, POS, fintech, payments, or business technology.
 



  





 Minimum 5 years of experience in the Kuwaiti market is required, with strong understanding of SMEs, restaurants, retail, and local customer behavior.
 



  





  





  





 13\. Language Requirement
 



  





 Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.
 



  





 The candidate must communicate professionally in both languages with customers, teams, partners, vendors, and senior management.
 



  





  





  





 14\. Required Skills
 



  





 Strong sales leadership, operational discipline, customer success mindset, problem\-solving, follow\-up, reporting, and team management skills.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organized, data\-driven, commercially strong, customer\-focused, and able to build processes and teams from scratch.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Commercial Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of complex projects, targeting candidates with a strong background in finance and project management. You will work on meaningful projects that shape the future of energy, ensuring commercial, financial, and contractual objectives are met, thereby contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions. Your work will have a significant impact on the team, clients, and partners, fostering a collaborative culture that values innovation, integrity, and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Collaborate with the Project Manager to deliver projects within agreed commercial, financial, time, and quality targets, ensuring customer satisfaction throughout the project life cycle.
* Coordinate with customers, suppliers, and internal departments to facilitate effective project execution and maintain strong relationships.
* Manage and control project financial performance, including orders, revenue, costs, profit, cash flow, receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital, aligning with budget and forecast.
* Support monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, controlling, and financial reporting activities to ensure accurate and timely financial insights.
* Drive optimization of project profitability, cash flow, and Net Capital Employed, maintaining a focus on financial health and sustainability.
* Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy policies, contractual terms, financial reporting guidelines, and local regulations, managing contracts, claims, and risk and opportunity topics.


**What You Bring**
* A university degree in Accounting, Finance, International Business, or related financial areas, providing a solid foundation for commercial project management.
* 3–5 years of experience in project controlling, commercial project management, or a comparable role, demonstrating a proven track record in managing complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS 15 and financial closing processes, ensuring adherence to international financial standards.
* Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications, enabling efficient management of project data and communication.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fostering collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Ability to maintain audit\-ready documentation and support internal/external audits, ensuring transparency and accountability in project execution.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

Founded on the principle that curiosity is the most powerful force in early childhood learning, BeCurious has built a proprietary curriculum framework, a structured operating system, and a community of families who choose us for the quality of thinking behind everything we do.
   

  

 We are growing. We are building. And we are looking for the person who will run the engine.
   

  

**The Role**
* The Director of Operations is the operational backbone of BeCurious.
* This is not a coordination role. It is not a support role. The DOO is the person who makes sure that every session in every branch is delivered at the BeCurious standard — consistently, day after day, across all three locations.
* The DOO sits between the General Manager (who sets direction and owns the brand) and the Branch Supervisors (who run daily operations). Everything that matters operationally flows through this role.
* This role is right for you if you have a genuine love for early childhood education, a precise and organized mind, and the ability to hold a high standard without rigidity. You must be comfortable holding people accountable with warmth — not through fear, and not by doing their job for them.


**Responsibilities**
* Operations — Three Branches, One Standard:
* Own the daily operational standard across all three branches — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa.
* Conduct monthly Branch Reviews with each Branch Supervisor (08\.1\) — reviewing KPIs, flagging patterns, agreeing action plans.
* Ensure every SOP in the BeCurious OS is being followed at branch level — and escalate deviations immediately.
* Manage the scheduling system — session allocation, teacher assignment, Home Preschool routing during continuity periods.
* Own the Feedback Log (08\.4\) — capture, categorize, and respond to all feedback across branches.
* Lead the Quarterly SOP Review (08\.2\) with the GM — identifying what is working, what needs updating, what needs a rebuild.
* Ensure branch readiness for Ministry inspections at all times — not just before announced visits.


**Team And Teaching Quality**
* Line manage Branch Supervisors — three direct reports. Support them. Challenge them. Hold them to the standard.
* Ensure all teaching staff are progressing through the Teacher Training Framework (02\.1\) at the required pace for their role.
* Conduct or coordinate classroom observations at minimum once per quarter per branch (03\.8 Classroom Observation Guide).
* Own the teacher evaluation process (04\.3\) — ensure evaluations are completed on schedule and that feedback leads to action
* Identify teaching staff who are ready to grow and flag them to the GM. Identify those who are struggling and build a support plan.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session alone without completing the required training stage for their role.


**Admissions And Enrollment**
* Own the admissions pipeline across all branches in Odoo — lead stages, conversion rates, follow\-up discipline.
* Oversee the Admissions Coordinator role — review their performance, support their work, escalate decisions that require GM involvement.
* Monitor enrollment capacity across branches — flag when a branch is approaching capacity or running below target.
* Ensure every family completing a tour receives a structured follow\-up within the required SOP timeframe.
* Review lead\-to\-tour and tour\-to\-enrollment conversion rates monthly — identify patterns and surface them to the GM.


**Curriculum And Learning Quality**
* Ensure monthly theme plans are submitted by Lead Teachers on schedule and reviewed before the month begins.
* Ensure weekly planning documents (03\.3\) are completed and filed — not treated as optional paperwork.
* Monitor child observation records (03\.7\) for consistency and quality — flag teachers who are not completing them.
* Ensure the Curiosity Lens Framework is visible in classroom practice — not just in documentation.
* Coordinate with the GM on curriculum development priorities for the year.


**Governance And Reporting**
* Attend the Weekly Leadership Meeting every Monday — present the Weekly Scorecard (09\.3\) and surface decisions that require GM input.
* Ensure the OS Change Log (00\) is updated whenever an SOP, template, or standard is modified.
* Manage incident documentation — ensure every incident has a completed 07\.5 Incident Report filed within 24 hours.
* Maintain the staff register in Odoo — civil IDs, health certificates, first aid certifications current for all staff at all times.
* Support the GM in preparing for the Annual Blueprint Review (08\.3\) — compiling the years evidence and identifying structural questions.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The DOO does not teach classes. This is a leadership and operational role.
* The DOO does not bypass Branch Supervisors to manage teachers directly — the chain of command is respected in both directions.
* The DOO does not make brand decisions — that is the GM's domain. The DOO executes brand standards. They do not change them.
* The DOO does not have financial signing authority above the limits in the authority matrix (04\.0\). Spending decisions above those limits go to the GM.
* The DOO's job is to make the standard work at scale. Not to be liked by everyone. Not to avoid difficult conversations. To make BeCurious excellent, consistently, across three branches.


**You Are The Right Person If**
**You will thrive in this role if you** 
 \|
 **This role is not right for you if you:**
* Have genuine experience in early childhood education or school operations — at least 4 years \| Are looking for a purely administrative or desk\-based role.
* Have managed a team before and understand that management means accountability, not friendship \| Expect to be liked by everyone you hold to a standard.
* Are organized to a degree that other people find remarkable — you track details without being reminded \| Find systematic documentation burdensome rather than protective.
* Can hold a high standard with warmth — you challenge people without humiliating them \| Prefer to avoid difficult conversations until they become crises.
* Are bilingual Arabic\-English — you operate at full professional quality in both languages \| Cannot communicate fluently and professionally in Arabic.
* Believe that curiosity in children is worth protecting — this is not a generic school for you \| See early childhood as a stepping stone to a different field.
* Understand that a system is what makes quality scalable — and you want to build that system \| Prefer to rely on improvisation and personal judgment over documented process.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 4 years of experience in early childhood education, preschool management, or educational operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team — minimum 3 direct reports.
* Bilingual Arabic and English — professional fluency in both.
* Practical experience with a school management system (Odoo, Brightwheel, or equivalent).
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately — this is a full presence role across three branches.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education, Educational Leadership, or Business Administration.
* Experience with Finnish or play\-based education methodology.
* Experience leading or contributing to a curriculum quality review process.
* Experience with the Kuwait Ministry of Social Affairs licensing and inspection process.
* Demonstrated track record of improving operational consistency in a multi\-site environment.


**What BeCurious Offers**
**What You Get \| Detail:**
* A real leadership role \| Not a coordinator title with manager responsibilities. The DOO has genuine authority and is expected to use it.
* A built operating system \| BeCurious has a documented OS — SOPs, templates, review cycles, governance. You are inheriting a system and improving it. You are not building from nothing.
* Direct access to the founder \| Weekly leadership meeting with the Strategic Head and General Manager. Your voice shapes what BeCurious becomes.
* A curriculum you can believe in \| The Curiosity Lens Framework is a genuine educational philosophy. This is not a franchise curriculum or a generic play programme.
* Compensation \| Competitive, commensurate with experience. Discussed at the offer stage.
* Growth \| As BeCurious grows — more branches, Club, Camp — the DOO role grows with it. The person who builds the operational foundation at this stage has a significant role in the next one.


**How to Apply?**
 Send your CV and a short cover note (no more than one page) to the BeCurious HR Lead. In your cover note, answer one question: 'What does operational excellence look like in an early childhood setting, and how have you contributed to it?'
   

  

 We do not require a formal cover letter. We require a genuine answer to that question. Applications without a response to the question will not be reviewed.
   

  

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
   

  

* First stage: written review of CV and cover note.
* Second stage: structured conversation with the General Manager.
* Third stage: structured conversation with the Strategic Head.
* Final stage: offer and reference check.


 We move fast for the right person.
   

  

**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

 A Director of Operations serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you must possesss the following qualifications, attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:
   

  

* A degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
* Strong commercial acumen, preferably with experience in Food and Beverage or Rooms Management
* Experience in managing budgets, revenue proposals and forecasting results
* In\-depth knowledge of the hotel / leisure / service sector
* Strong leadership skills to effectively manage and motivate the team to achieve high level of perform and exceed targets

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The AI Solution/Platform Architect defines technical solution designs and ensures alignment with Group AI reference architecture across all AI initiatives. This role conducts architecture reviews, provides design guidance to delivery teams, resolves complex technical dependencies, and ensures OpCo implementations comply with Group standards. The Architect partners with the Director, Tech \& Platforms on platform strategy and reference architecture evolution, engages with OpCo technical teams on solution design, and serves as the technical escalation point for delivery teams. This role requires deep understanding of AI architectures, enterprise integration patterns, and the ability to balance technical purity with pragmatic business constraints in a federated organization.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end technical solutions for AI use cases ensuring alignment with Group reference architecture
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide design guidance to delivery teams and OpCo technical staff
* Resolve complex technical dependencies across enterprise systems, data sources, and platforms
* Ensure OpCo AI implementations comply with Group architecture standards or have documented exceptions
* Partner with Director, Tech \& Platforms on reference architecture definition and evolution
* Define integration patterns for AI systems with enterprise platforms (CRM, BSS/OSS, data platforms)
* Support platform evaluation and vendor selection with technical due diligence and architecture assessment
* Create architecture blueprints, design patterns, and technical reference materials for reuse
* Serve as technical escalation point for delivery teams on complex architecture challenges
* Engage with OpCo architects and technical leads to drive architecture alignment and knowledge sharing


**KPIs Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Architecture compliance: percentage of solutions compliant with reference architecture
* Design quality: solution architecture quality as measured by peer reviews and production issues
* Reusability: number of reusable patterns and accelerators created and adopted
* OpCo alignment: percentage of OpCos aligned to Group architecture standards
* Technical escalation resolution: time to resolve complex architecture issues


 What We Need From You
   

  

 Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
   

  

 Experience: 10\+ years in technology roles with 5\+ years in solution architecture or enterprise architecture. Experience designing AI/ML solutions, enterprise integrations, and cloud architectures. Background in telecom BSS/OSS systems or complex regulated industries valuable.
   

  

 Knowledge: Deep understanding of AI/ML architectures (GenAI, traditional ML, automation), enterprise integration patterns, cloud platforms, and data architectures. Experience with architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and governance. Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

**Job Description**
**Department: Center of Continuing Education**
**Reports to:** 
**Director \- CCE**
**Scope And Purpose**
 Center for Continuing Education (CCE) is committed to providing a wide range of professional development courses, training workshops, certificate programs, and customized corporate training solutions designed to meet the needs of individuals, businesses, and the community. By partnering with international certifying bodies and industry experts, the Center ensures that its programs are globally relevant, innovative, and aligned with labor market demands.
   

  

 The Training Operation Officer supports the effective delivery of CCE programs and training services by managing daily operational, logistical, and administrative processes. This role ensures that classes, instructors, and facilities are efficiently scheduled and prepared, that quality standards are consistently maintained, and that all post\-training documentation and reports are accurately completed. Working closely with the Team leader \- Training operation \& testing and the CCE Director, the training operations officer plays a key role in ensuring a seamless learning experience for participants and operational excellence across all CCE activities.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Coordinate Training Operations: Plan and manage the scheduling and setup of CCE training programs, ensuring all logistical, technical, and material requirements are met.
* Administer CCE Systems, Data, and Operational Schedules: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within CCE’s management systems, including product sheets, class openings, participant and instructor data, and operational reports. Develop and monitor the annual training calendar, trainers’ schedules, and classroom allocations to ensure effective resource management, operational efficiency, and accurate reporting.
* Monitor Quality and Service Standards:Oversee training delivery and gather feedback from participants and instructors to uphold CCE’s quality benchmarks.
* Support Instructors and Participants:Communicate essential course information, coordinate instructor schedules, and provide responsive support to ensure a positive learning experience.
* Oversee Facilities and Logistics:Ensure training venues, equipment, and course materials are properly arranged and maintained to create an effective learning environment.
* Maintain Administrative Efficiency:Process course\-related forms, certificates, cancellations, and transfers promptly to ensure compliance and smooth program operations.
* Manage Testing Center Operations: Coordinate scheduling, setup, and supervision of CCE testing activities, ensuring proper administration of exams, adherence to testing protocols, and maintenance of a secure and professional testing environment.
* Process Trainer Payments and Financial Requisitions: Prepare and process trainer payment requests \& handle BC petty cash advances.


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Education, Management Information Systems, or a related field is required.


**Experience**
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in training administration, program coordination, or operation management, preferably within a university, continuing education, or professional training enviroment.
* Demonstrated experience managing trainign logistics, scheduling course setup, and reporting systems.
* Experience with testing center operations,including exam scheduling, supervision, and compliance with testing protocols, is highly desirable.


**Key Competencies**
* Administration: Effectively plans and coordinates tasks, resources, and schedules to ensure smooth execution of training and testing activities.
* Quality Management: Maintains high standards of accuracy and thoroughness in all operational and administrative processes.
* Applying Technology: Demonstrates proficiency in CCE systems, digital tools, and IT processes required for training delivery and reporting.
* Process Excellence: Understands, follows, and improves operational workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Information and Data Management: Collects, organizes, and analyzes data to generate accurate reports that support decision\-making and performance tracking.
* Office Management: Manages physical and digital resources—such as training rooms, materials, and equipment—to ensure readiness and proper utilization.
* Communication Skills: Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with colleagues, trainers, and learners to foster collaboration and understanding.
* Service Orientation: Demonstrates commitment to providing high\-quality service to internal and external stakeholders through responsiveness and professionalism.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, delivers on commitments, and ensures consistent performance and dependability.
* Teamwork: Works cooperatively with others across departments to achieve shared goals and support organizational effectiveness.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to change, adjusting priorities and approaches to meet evolving operational and institutional needs.
* Self Management: Seeks opportunities to enhance personal effectiveness, update knowledge, and contribute to process improvement within the CCE.


**Certifications (preferred)**
* Project Management certification.
* Training Administration or Learning Management Systems (LMS)certification.
* Customer Service or Quality Management certification.
* Information Technology proficiency certification.

**About BeCurious**
 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Built on the belief that curiosity drives learning, BeCurious combines a strong curriculum with a structured operating system.
   

  

 Each branch must operate at the same standard — every day, in every classroom. The Branch Manager is the person who makes that real on the ground.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Branch Manager owns the day\-to\-day operation of one BeCurious branch.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is not administrative oversight. The Branch Manager ensures that every session, every teacher, and every family experience meets the BeCurious standard — consistently, without exception.
   

  

 You are responsible for execution. What is designed at system level must work in your branch — through people, discipline, and attention to detail.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Daily Operations — One Branch, Full Standard:
   

  

* Own the daily running of the branch from opening to closing.
* Ensure all sessions run on time and to standard.
* Execute all SOPs exactly as designed in the BeCurious OS.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and fully prepared environment at all times.
* Ensure readiness for inspections at any time.


**Team Management**
* Manage all teachers and support staff within the branch.
* Lead daily briefings and ensure team alignment.
* Hold staff accountable to performance standards.
* Support teacher development through coaching and feedback.

**Teaching \& Classroom Quality**

* Ensure lesson plans and weekly planning are completed and followed.
* Ensure child observation records are completed properly.
* Maintain visible application of the Curiosity Lens Framework.


**Parent Experience**

**Admissions Support**

**Inventory \& Supplies**

* Ensure incident reports are completed within required timelines.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The Branch Manager does not operate without structure — SOPs are followed, not reinvented.
* This is not a passive supervisory role — you are actively managing every day.
* The Branch Manager does not avoid accountability conversations.
* This role is not about being liked — it is about maintaining standards.


**You Are The Right Person If**
 You will thrive in this role if you:
   

  

* Are highly organized and present on the floor.
* Can manage people with clarity and firmness.
* Pay attention to detail others miss.
* Take full ownership of outcomes, not excuses.

**This Role Is Not Right For You If You**
* Prefer planning over execution.
* Avoid difficult conversations with staff or parents.

* Experience in early childhood education.

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**




 We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Lighting Sales Manager with a strong background in managing medium and large\-scale lighting projects across Kuwait. The ideal candidate will have well\-established relationships with engineering consultants, main contractors, and end clients, and will be capable of leading a sales team while personally driving key account development. You will take ownership of the full project sales cycle — from early specification influence through to order closure and delivery coordination.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Sales Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Develop and execute a structured sales strategy for lighting projects aligned with the company's annual revenue targets and growth objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the lighting sales team, setting individual targets and conducting regular performance reviews.
* Report weekly and monthly project pipeline status and sales performance directly to the Managing Director.



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key engineering consultants, MEP contractors, main contractors, interior designers, and project owners across Kuwait.
* Conduct regular client visits, site surveys, and design\-stage meetings to influence lighting specifications in favour of the company's portfolio.
* Act as a senior point of contact for key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.



**Technical \& Commercial Sales** 



* Prepare and present detailed technical proposals, lighting design concepts, and commercial quotations tailored to project requirements and budgets.
* Review tender documents, BOQs, and consultant specifications to ensure correct product selection and full compliance.
* Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and supply agreements with clients, contractors, and manufacturers to close orders profitably.
* Collaborate with manufacturer representatives and technical teams to deliver customised lighting solutions, mock\-ups, and value\-engineering alternatives.



**Project Execution \& Coordination** 



* Oversee order handling, delivery scheduling, and documentation (product data sheets, photometric reports, warranties, and certifications) to ensure on\-time project delivery.
* Monitor active projects to ensure alignment with client timelines, budget constraints, and technical specifications.
* Resolve post\-sale technical issues and coordinate with suppliers to manage warranties, replacements, and site support.



**Market Intelligence \& Business Development** 



* Identify and pursue new project opportunities in commercial, hospitality, retail, government, healthcare, and infrastructure segments across Kuwait.
* Conduct ongoing market research to track competitor activity, new project awards, and emerging lighting technology trends.
* Evaluate and expand the company's lighting product portfolio in response to market demand and project requirements.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Minimum 8 years of lighting project sales experience in Kuwait, with a demonstrated track record of managing medium and large\-scale projects from specification to delivery.
* Strong existing network of relationships with engineering consultants, MEP contractors, and procurement decision\-makers in the Kuwait market.
* Proficiency in lighting design and calculation software (DIALux, Relux, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.
* Solid commercial acumen with experience in tender preparation, BOQ analysis, and contract negotiation.
* Prior experience in a managerial or team\-lead sales capacity.
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English
* Valid Kuwait driving licence; must be based in Kuwait with a transferable residency visa.

data.jd_text:
**JOB PURPOSE:** 




 The
 
 Manager – Information Security will be responsible for managing FAB Kuwait’s Information Security, Business Continuity and Data Privacy Program. He/She serves as the process owner of the appropriate second\-line functional activities related to confidentiality, integrity, availability of Information assets in addition to Data Privacy and Buiness continuity as well third party risk management and physical security in compliance with regulatory requirements.
 



  





 The role will report directly to the Head of Risk – Kuwait and functionally to the Head of International Information Security at the Group, and shall be responsible to plan, implement, monitor and review the information security program for FAB Kuwait in consultation with Group Information Security Office – Head office team. The Manager – Information Security shall ensure the information security program, Data Privacy program and Business Continuity Management Program is in alignment with the regulatory, legal and statutory requirements of FAB Kuwait and the business strategy. The Manager – Information Security role will be operating out of the FAB Kuwait branch.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 



* Review and Maintain Information Security, Buisness Contnuity and Data Privacy Policies, Standards, and Procedures for FAB Kuwait.
* Participate in discussions and coordinate activities between local business units, support functions, Compliance Team, IT and GSO – HO for information security and Data Privacy, related planning, implementations and review.
* Ensure compliance as per regulatory requirements (all Information Security / Bsiness Continuity/ Personal Data Protection specific regulations applicabe to FAB Kuwait / Third party risk management / Physical security .).
* Provide regular reporting on the status of information security program, initiatives, security \& technology risks and relevant incidents to the executive management.
* Laise with external agencies such as regulatory/advManager \- Information Securityry/law enforcement bodies, as necessary, to ensure that the FAB Kuwait maintains a strong security posture and is kept well abreast of relevant threats identified by these agencies.
* Review new regulatory legislations; promptly communicate all regulatory notices/circulars to all concerned areas, provide interpretations if necessary; develop/monitor action plans towards its implementation.
* Assist Head office during Regulatory Examinations; ensure implementation/regularization of observations linked to compliance while meeting the deadline(s).
* Review Technology Risk Assessments for IT Projects, RCSA , Third party and Facility Risk assessments.
* Assist and support for Internal and External Audits. Monitor and track all open infosec issues with IT and concerned stakeholders.
* Oversee the tracking and closure of Security, BCM \& Privacy related Audit findings of FAB Kuwait.
* Govern the security awareness program for FAB Kuwait staff and customers.
* Provide support to FAB CSIRT and Group Data privacy for information security incident response and personal data breach handling.
* Provide SLOD oversight and support the business unit on the implementation of business continuity program in line with local regulatory requirements and Group BCM framework practices and RACI.
* Coordination with Business units/Fraud Risk / GSO for digital forensic investigation.
* Review and assess the regulatory circulars/notices, discuss with GSO\-HO and enforce security controls as applicable.
* Assist Group Information Security Office– Head Office team in delivery of information security services to the branch such as vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, SOC monitoring etc.
* Review Management Dashboards/Security MIS related to Patching, VA, PT, Baselines and end point security controls and highlight risks to the branch executive management.
* Assess and Review Change Requests and Security Exceptions for FAB Kuwait.
* Review BRDs, Solution Design, Product Papers from Information Security, Data Privacy and Busines Continuity perspective and any other requirements for FAB Kuwait business units.
* Review and track compliance for Data Privacy and Protection controls.
* Review KPI and KRI for country information security processes.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 



* Information Security or IT Security or IS Audit background.
* Must be having a minimum 8 years of Information Security Experience.
* Expert knowledge of Information Security Domains and should be certified (CISA, CISSP or CISM or any other relevant security certification).
* Experience in a similar type of role in a multinational business and dealing with regulatory authorities, governments and industry bodies.
* Experience in managing security compliance teams.
* Knowledge of CBK regulatios on Cyber security, Business continuity, \& local privacy regulations.
* Ability to comply with Data Privacy Policy / procedures, draft / update local Data Privacy Polcies. Review local Business initiatives and SOPs where required, for compliance with Data Privacy Compliance requirements in co\-ordination with H.O. Teams.
* Ability to make good judgments regarding security risk and to prioritize resources and activity around managing those risks.
* Able to conduct the role independently and with integrity.
* Ability to plan, organize and prioritize tasks and projects.
* Good personal communication skills capable of dealing with wide range of stakeholders, including senior management.
* Fluent (spoken and written) in English, Arabic.

 The
 **Service Operations Manager**
